purpose: Design reference only; runtime native pixels and animation are authored by tools/build_livestock.py.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: animal pixel-art reference and animation design board for the ORIGINAL cozy farming game Dewfield. Create one polished landscape reference sheet, approximately 1536x1024. Five columns: HEN, DUCK, COW, SHEEP, PIG. Four clean, spacious rows: ADULT IDLE, BABY + JUVENILE, WALK KEY POSES, EAT KEY POSES. Show fully ORIGINAL farm animals, consistent with a refined GBA-era overhead farming RPG. Slightly elevated 3/4 top-down camera: visible backs and shoulders, heads projected toward the near/right side; avoid pure flat side-view animals. These animals will ultimately be hand-authored on native 32x28 pixel canvases, so use clear, economical, exquisitely designed pixel clusters and a compact silhouette: elegant faces, tiny readable eyes, proper hooves and beaks, no long thin stick legs, no oversized toy heads. Display the small sprites at an integer enlargement so every pixel is crisp. NO blurred painting, no gradients, no antialiasing, no 3D rendering. Palette must fit warm muted olive grass, amber wood, terracotta roofs, teal water and a brunette farmer in ochre clothing: dark warm brown outlines, creamy ivory highlights, desaturated ochre/grey shadows; hen ivory with rust-red comb, duck ivory with muted sage wing and amber wide bill, cow warm ivory with charcoal-brown irregular patches and soft rose muzzle, sheep layered ivory wool curls with taupe face and dark small hooves, pig dusty peach-rose with gentle maroon-brown shading. Babies are genuinely smaller anatomical variants, juveniles intermediate, adults rounded but not bloated. WALK row: two or three small distinct poses per animal with clear alternating legs, diagonal paired quadruped gait, opposing body weight, subtle head/tail movement, planted-foot ground contact. EAT row: distinct standing-to-lowered-head-to-chew poses, hens/ducks pecking scattered grain, cow/sheep/pig lowering neck toward a tiny hay tuft, body and feet stay firmly on one baseline. Small subtle ground-contact shadows only beneath feet; no floating animals, no broad black ellipses. Off-white warm paper background, tidy grid dividers and very small understated English labels. No game HUD, no logos, no copyrighted game characters, no decorative landscape. This is a REFERENCE board, not a runtime sprite atlas: prioritize appealing anatomy, a coherent overhead perspective and usable pose ideas.
